paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Fleiss Kappa agreement scores alongside corresponding ambiguity values. The horizontal axis represents the “Max Ambiguity” category, displaying values ranging from 0 to 3, with tick labels indicating integer values. The vertical axis, labeled “Fleiss Kappa,” represents the inter-annotator agreement, with a scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, utilizing a linear scale and evenly spaced tick intervals. The bars, colored blue, correspond to the “Ambiguity Std” and “Max Ambiguity” values, and their approximate heights indicate the corresponding Kappa scores. The bar representing “Max Ambiguity” with a value of 2 has the highest height, measuring approximately 0.89, while the bar representing “Ambiguity Std” with a value of 0.03 has the shortest height, measuring approximately 0.23. The bars are not sorted; however, the bar representing “Max Ambiguity” with a value of 1 is visually emphasized with a slight shading.
